response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(f.rebrate / f.feerate) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS fee_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(fee_count) AS avg_fee_count FROM grouped) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(g.fee_count) AS total_fee_records, AVG(g.fee_count - b.avg_fee_count) AS avg_count_excess FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.fee_count > b.avg_fee_count
